title: Trace resident tilemap pages back to the ROM-side map loader
goal: Trace the load path that populates the confirmed scene-specific VRAM pages 0x1000 and 0x1800, through DMA/CPU VRAM transfer and any WRAM staging/decompression, to a candidate ROM pointer/table or canonical map record.
definition_of_done: At least one code path responsible for populating VRAM 0x1000..0x1FFF during map load is identified.
The transfer is connected to its source buffer/pointer or decompressor/decoder with static or runtime evidence.
A ROM-side source range, pointer table, or map-record candidate is identified strongly enough to drive the next extraction experiment.
The result and unresolved gaps are committed without raw VRAM/ROM payloads.

done.item: Map/world reconstruction workstream and completion levels L0..L5 defined.
Deterministic remote lab pauses between commands and advances only explicitly requested frames.
Remote-lab launcher supports unthrottled maximum-speed execution while preserving exact frame counts; normal speed remains available explicitly.
Runtime map capture command implemented for VRAM/CGRAM/OAM/screenshot/manifest where the active core exposes the relevant domains.
PPU-independent VRAM tilemap-page ranker implemented with fill/high-priority false-positive penalties.
VRAM plus screenshot BG-parameter inference prototype implemented; current correlations are candidate evidence only.
PPU/CGRAM mirroring path was corrected to follow the proven BizHawk onmemorywrite call convention, but the active Snes9x core still needs a fresh stable-map validation capture.
First reproducible L1 structural map sample completed: same-scene captures preserve VRAM pages 0x1000 and 0x1800 byte-for-byte, while a transition control rewrites 2047/2048 bytes respectively.

observed_not_yet_promoted.observation: PPU register callbacks remain null on the active Snes9x core despite successful hook registration.
observed_not_yet_promoted.reason_not_promoted: Use VRAM-delta and loader/DMA tracing instead of inferring register values.

observed_not_yet_promoted.observation: 0xA000 is structurally map-like but unchanged across the interior/transition comparison.
observed_not_yet_promoted.reason_not_promoted: It is not scene-specific for the L1 interior sample.

observed_not_yet_promoted.observation: The existing screenshot-correlation brute force does not visually reproduce the room strongly enough to claim bpp/character-base parameters.
observed_not_yet_promoted.reason_not_promoted: Do not use it as proof of BG configuration.

in_progress: Locate static/runtime writers or DMA paths targeting VRAM 0x1000..0x1FFF.
Connect the transfer source to WRAM staging/decompression or directly to ROM.
Identify the first map loader/source-table candidate.

next_actions.action: Verify latest main HEAD and inspect existing graphics/mapchip/DMA analyses before adding a parallel loader theory.
Search existing disassembly and graphics probes for VRAM address setup or DMA transfers that can target 0x1000/0x1800.
Use the stable interior load as a runtime trigger if static evidence leaves multiple candidates; log only derived DMA/source metadata.
Resolve the source buffer/pointer/decompressor chain and identify a ROM-side map-table or record candidate.
Commit the loader evidence and update this checkpoint before broadening to whole-ROM map enumeration.

do_not_redo: Do not redesign the pause/exact-frame remote-lab model.
Do not rerun the weak screenshot-correlation experiment as proof of BG parameters.
Do not treat 0xA000 as the interior map page; it is unchanged across the transition control.
Do not commit raw ROM, savestate, SRAM, VRAM, CGRAM or OAM dumps.
Do not force older handoffs over newer main commits.

runtime_only_artifacts.description: First same-room raw capture used for L1 page stability.
Fresh stable-room capture at frame 3253 used for L1 page stability.
Transition control used to prove that pages 0x1000/0x1800 are scene-specific.

chat_policy.resume_behavior: Read this file, verify latest main, then continue from next_actions[0] without redoing done/do_not_redo items.
